purpose: Conventional scientific publication figures redrawn from verified records and actual arrays; no generative image synthesis
panel_letters: uppercase bold 10pt placed outside axes without overlapping headings

style.grid: none or very light horizontal when essential
style.legends: direct labels or compact single shared legend; captions outside graphic

case_images.pixels: released ultrasound inputs unchanged, no contrast enhancement or invented anatomy
case_images.rendering: nearest-neighbor; full field preserved unless identical explicitly documented crop
case_images.boundary: contours at binary0.5; all foreground preserved

scientific_invariants: original H1-H3 and Newcombe intervals unchanged
empirical bootstrap frequencies are not p-values/population probabilities
6cases are existing patients; 30 masks are not 30 patients
R1 zero A-only support constraint retained
format_authority: BMT current official author guide; no publisher logo or journal-page imitation
